# evaluation-reports — LGD-Eval 评测报告库（Published Reports）
> LLM-friendly entry. / 面向 AI 的入口。

## What (是什么)
Published evaluation reports with evidence-grade conclusions. / 已发布的评测报告（带证据等级结论）。

## Report structure (报告结构)
Scope & exclusions · Method & judge cards · Domain-level risk of bias · Findings with interpretation levels (Verified/Strong/Moderate/Limited/Preliminary) · Evidence appendix · Standards mapping · Responses & corrections. / 范围与排除·方法学与判官卡·域级偏倚·分级发现·证据附录·标准映射·回应更正。

## Key files (关键文件)
- README.md — report index / 报告索引
- TEST_REPORT_FULL.md — full real-run test report of our own five repos / 本机构自测全量报告
- MedXpert工具链实测报告.md — live evaluation of the MedXpert toolchain / 产品号实测
- INDEX — leaderboard & aggregate index / 榜单与聚合索引（随主动评测上线）

*Evaluating Autonomy. Verifying Governance. / 评测自治之物，验证治理主张。*
